notes.title: Imagine Lifetimes - Language Update 2.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey Steam!

It's been quite some time since the last update, but we've added 3 new languages to the game!

In-game translation options are now available for:
- English
- Dutch
- Spanish (NEW)
- Brazilian Portuguese (NEW)
- Greek  (NEW)

Community translators have been working tirelessly in the background to provide full in-game translations of all subtitles and texts in Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Greek!

This was my first release, so I naturally underestimated the sheer volume of work required to add new languages to the game. Huge shout-out to the community translators involved! The amount of dedication and effort it took to translate every single line of text in the game to another language is just incredible.

CREDITS:

TheFastSpace - Spanish translations
Kauã Francisco Moreira - Brazilian Portuguese translations
Bamb8s - Greek translations

In addition, I'd like to thank you all once again for playing the game. It means a lot to me that you were there to support something I've created. (if you are able to leave a review, that'd be tremendously helpful) I'm in the middle of learning how to create 3D games, which is something I'd love to pursue in the future.

Cheers,
- Tim (Frycandle)

notes.title: Imagine Lifetimes - Patch 2.0.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36644638/6f4ba5fb013d6b556a4bcf167d6dac5024abdc77.png

Hey Steam!

This tiny patch is geared towards improving replay-ability for you, allowing you to skip (optional) through the opening credits. These are simple additions, but hopefully they will make your life a bit easier! :)

Most of these hints / skips will only become visible after having at least one ending completed. It made sense to apply this requirement because some things are best not skipped on your very first play. 


 You can now press ENTER during the opening credits to skip ahead
(you will see a hint for this during the opening credits after having at least 1 ending completed)

 You can now press ENTER during any of the egg-cell fertilization sequences to skip ahead
(you can also click on the fast-forward button during any of the egg-cell fertilization sequences)

 You are no longer required to read the content warning after having at least 1 ending completed


Last but not least, you'll notice a teeny tiny visual change inside the light-bulb. Clicking the light-bulb inside the imagination menu (brain) will take you to the hidden backstory. This feature wasn't obvious enough so from now it includes a small arrow animation pointing upwards... *hint-hint!*

Go check it out, only 1% of all total players has uncovered the true ending and finale credits so far! :)

Cheers,
-Tim (Frycandle)

notes.title: Imagine Lifetimes - Patch 2.0.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36644638/36680d4081b018810bce72fdae30cda6fb7dec9f.png

Hey Steam!

The first 24 hours of the Imagine Lifetimes release are almost behind us. Thank you all so much for the support so far. The game seems stable and no bugs have been reported so far, that's great news!

Based on a handful of reviews, the average playtime and % unlocked of certain achievements, this patch solves some simple but important design flaws. Data shows that when players reach their first ending they assume they've completed the game and quit early. This is a design flaw, because the game has multiple endings (20) and is meant to be played and explored on loop.

With each new ending unlocked, new paths become available throughout and the content intensifies.

The retirement path and ending seemed to be the main culprit. Here's some small but vital fixes:

 The achievement for this ending unlocked too early prior to dying, this is now fixed
 After completing this ending a text will be displayed (Ending 1/20) indicating your progress
 If you press quit [X] or clear [C] during this ending sequence, you will skip ahead and be reborn
 Once reborn, clicking anything will unlock your imagination, a vital part of the game

From now on, as long as you have at least 1 ending completed, you will definitely be able to find the imagination (brain). This is where all your progress is stored, displaying all your completed endings, secrets and challenges. You'll also be able to uncover the main backstory cut-scenes in this menu.

Hopefully these fixes will improve the experience for you. Thank you for your honest feedback and please do keep sending me your thoughts. Your reviews are extremely valuable for the growth of this game. 

If you've played and experienced a good chunk of the game, please consider leaving your review.

Cheers,
-Tim (Frycandle)

P.S. Special thanks to the ZFAM for waiting on this update! <3
